record_reviews.summary: Hunt apologizes for delayed reply after leaving town, restates Darwin’s experimental aim of using absorbent media to reproduce latitudinal solar conditions, separates sunlight into actinism/light/heat with proposed Norway–Italy–tropical proportions, assigns actinism to germination and chemistry, light to lignification and heat to flowering, and encloses small coloured-glass pieces. He recommends preliminary tests rather than treating colour alone as sufficient.

record_reviews.summary: Hunt corrects Darwin’s understanding of the glasses: the supplied samples are not the three effective types from Researches. He specifies intense cobalt blue for germination, silver yellow for lignification and deep copper red for flowering, directs Darwin to write to M. Bontemps at Chance Brothers in Birmingham, offers use of his name, and promises help despite leaving town.
record_reviews.date_assessment: 24 July 1855 exact XML day; direct incoming follow-up three days after Darwin’s request. The phrase “glasses which I sent you” confirms the earlier specimen receipt, but dispatch timing of those samples remains implicit.
record_reviews.attribution_assessment: Robert Hunt’s three body blocks are his own advice; Bontemps and Chance Brothers are named routing participants, not co-authors. The editorial footnote maps the colours to Hunt 1854 pages and does not replace the body.

record_reviews.summary: Darwin says the enclosed manufacturer correspondence has thrown him back into uncertainty, asks Hunt to read and return it, and specifically asks whether glass coated with colour differs from glass coloured throughout. He transcribes the three requested specifications—intense cobalt blue, silver yellow and deep copper red—and says he used Hunt’s name and stated that the experiment concerns plants. The enclosure itself is missing, but the editorial apparatus identifies it as a Chance Brothers query.
record_reviews.date_assessment: 31 July [1855] exact XML day; the date is explicit and follows Hunt’s 24 July advice. The missing enclosure prevents reading the manufacturer’s exact questions or price, so only Darwin’s surviving summary is evidence.
record_reviews.attribution_assessment: Darwin writes all surviving body blocks; the unlocated Chance Brothers document is an external institutional voice and must not be reconstructed.
